database_summary: Small OLTP-style schema focused on products and sales. Key domains: products (with descriptions, categories, subcategories, models->cultures), sales orders and order lines, salespeople and territories, currency rates and country-currency mapping, and salesperson quota history. Mix of current-state tables (product, salesperson, salesterritory) and event/history tables (salesorderheader/detail, currencyrate, SalesPersonQuotaHistory). Row counts indicate large fact tables for orders/lines and moderate dimension tables for products.

accepted.name: product_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  NAME,
  productnumber,
  makeflag,
  finishedgoodsflag,
  color,
  safetystocklevel,
  reorderpoint,
  standardcost,
  listprice,
  size,
  sizeunitmeasurecode,
  weightunitmeasurecode,
  weight,
  daystomanufacture,
  productline,
  class,
  style,
  productsubcategoryid,
  productmodelid,
  sellstartdate,
  sellenddate,
  discontinueddate,
  rowguid,
  modifieddate
FROM product
accepted.description: Normalized product dimension: one row per product with key descriptive attributes and core measures (listprice, standardcost). Useful as a clean product lookup for joins or downstream aggregations. | Use for: List product attributes for reporting or join to sales/order lines; Filter products by category/subcategory/model or price ranges; Compute product-level margins using listprice and standardcost

accepted.name: product_with_category
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.productid,
  p.NAME,
  p.productnumber,
  p.productsubcategoryid,
  p.productmodelid,
  p.listprice,
  p.standardcost,
  p.productline,
  p.class,
  p.style,
  p.rowguid,
  p.modifieddate,
  ps.productsubcategoryid AS productsubcategory_productsubcategoryid,
  ps.productcategoryid AS productsubcategory_productcategoryid,
  ps.name AS productsubcategory_name,
  pc.productcategoryid AS productcategory_productcategoryid,
  pc.name AS productcategory_name
FROM product p
LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
accepted.description: Denormalized product rows joined to subcategory and category names. One row per product with productcategory and productsubcategory context for reporting and aggregation by category. | Use for: Aggregate sales by product category/subcategory; List products with category context; Filter products belonging to categories or subcategories

accepted.name: sales_orders_flat
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  sod.salesorderid,
  sod.salesorderdetailid,
  sod.orderqty,
  sod.productid,
  sod.specialofferid,
  sod.unitprice,
  sod.unitpricediscount,
  sod.rowguid AS rowguid,
  sod.modifieddate AS modifieddate,
  soh.orderdate,
  soh.duedate,
  soh.shipdate,
  soh.STATUS,
  soh.onlineorderflag,
  soh.customerid,
  soh.salespersonid,
  soh.territoryid,
  soh.subtotal,
  soh.taxamt,
  soh.freight,
  soh.totaldue,
  p.NAME AS NAME,
  p.listprice AS listprice,
  (sod.unitprice * sod.orderqty * (1.0 - COALESCE(sod.unitpricediscount,0.0))) AS line_extended_amount
FROM salesorderdetail sod
LEFT JOIN salesorderheader soh ON sod.salesorderid = soh.salesorderid
LEFT JOIN product p ON sod.productid = p.productid
accepted.description: Denormalized sales order lines joined to order header and product to produce one row per sales order line with order-level and product-level attributes and line revenue measures. | Use for: Compute revenue or quantity by product, salesperson, territory, date ranges; Identify high-value order lines or returns (joins to product attributes); Feed into time-series aggregation by orderdate

accepted.name: sales_by_order
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  soh.salesorderid,
  soh.orderdate,
  soh.customerid,
  soh.salespersonid,
  soh.territoryid,
  COUNT(sod.salesorderdetailid) AS order_line_count,
  SUM(sod.orderqty) AS total_order_qty,
  SUM(sod.unitprice * sod.orderqty * (1.0 - COALESCE(sod.unitpricediscount,0.0))) AS total_order_amount,
  soh.subtotal,
  soh.taxamt,
  soh.freight,
  soh.totaldue
FROM salesorderheader soh
LEFT JOIN salesorderdetail sod ON soh.salesorderid = sod.salesorderid
GROUP BY soh.salesorderid, soh.orderdate, soh.customerid, soh.salespersonid, soh.territoryid, soh.subtotal, soh.taxamt, soh.freight, soh.totaldue
accepted.description: Aggregate measures at the salesorderid (order) level: total_order_qty and total_order_amount derived from order lines, joined to order header. Useful for order-level KPIs and trend analysis. | Use for: Order-level revenue and quantity reporting; Comparing aggregated line totals to header totals for data quality; Filtering orders by salesperson/territory and aggregating metrics

accepted.name: salesperson_quota_history_norm
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  BusinessEntityID,
  QuotaDate,
  SalesQuota,
  rowguid,
  ModifiedDate
FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
accepted.description: Normalized SalesPerson quota history with consistent column names and parsed date. One row per quota history record to analyze quotas over time per BusinessEntityID. | Use for: Trend analysis of salesperson quotas over time; Join quotas to salesperson current state to compute attainment vs quota

accepted.name: salesperson_performance_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  soh.salespersonid,
  COUNT(DISTINCT soh.salesorderid) AS orders_count,
  SUM(soh.subtotal) AS sum_subtotal,
  SUM(soh.totaldue) AS sum_totaldue,
  AVG(soh.totaldue) AS avg_order_totaldue
FROM salesorderheader soh
GROUP BY soh.salespersonid
accepted.description: Aggregated sales metrics per salesperson across order headers: count of orders, total_subtotal and total_totaldue. One row per salesperson. Useful for ranking salespeople by revenue or activity. | Use for: Rank or compare salesperson revenue and activity; Join to salesperson table to compute attainment vs quota or commissions

accepted.name: product_review_stats
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  COUNT(productreviewid) AS review_count,
  AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
  MAX(reviewdate) AS most_recent_review_date
FROM productreview
GROUP BY productid
accepted.description: Aggregated review metrics per product: count of reviews, average rating, and most recent review date. One row per product. Useful for product quality signals and filtering by popularity or rating. | Use for: Find products with highest average rating or most reviews; Join review aggregates to product listings or sales to study impact of reviews on sales

accepted.name: salesorderheader_rank_by_date
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  salesorderid,
  customerid,
  orderdate,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY orderdate DESC, salesorderid DESC) AS order_rank
FROM salesorderheader
accepted.description: Ranked orders per customer by orderdate (1 = most recent). One row per salesorderid with customer-level order rank. Useful for selecting latest-N orders per customer. | Use for: Get latest order(s) per customer; Analyze customer recency or compute metrics on recent orders

accepted.name: territory_sales_trend
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  soh.territoryid,
  DATE(soh.orderdate) AS order_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT soh.salesorderid) AS orders_count,
  SUM(soh.subtotal) AS sum_subtotal,
  SUM(soh.totaldue) AS sum_totaldue
FROM salesorderheader soh
GROUP BY soh.territoryid, DATE(soh.orderdate)
accepted.description: Aggregated sales totals by territory and orderdate (date grain): daily/weekly/monthly rollups can be derived by grouping on orderdate. One row per territory x orderdate. | Use for: Time series of sales by territory; Compare territory performance across time windows

accepted.name: currencyrate_latest_per_pair
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  currencyrateid,
  currencyratedate,
  fromcurrencycode,
  tocurrencycode,
  averagerate,
  endofdayrate,
  modifieddate,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fromcurrencycode, tocurrencycode ORDER BY currencyratedate DESC, currencyrateid DESC) AS pair_rate_rank
FROM currencyrate
accepted.description: Latest currency rate per (fromcurrencycode, tocurrencycode) pair using currencyratedate. One row per currency pair holding the most recent rates and dates. | Use for: Get latest exchange rate per currency pair for conversions; Trend analysis of exchange rates by pair
